analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-buffer-overflow is caused by Type_ViewingConditions_Write blindly casting the tag payload pointer to cmsICCViewingConditions* and reading two cmsCIEXYZ structs plus a uint32 (52 bytes) without validating the allocated size/type of Ptr. In this PoV, cmsReadTag(hProfile, cmsSigGamutTag) loads a LUT8 tag object (allocated via cmsPipelineAlloc, 40 bytes), but during profile save the same data is emitted through the viewing-conditions writer path, so _cmsWriteXYZNumber reads past the 40-byte heap object at sc->SurroundXYZ.Z.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Using cms_profile_fuzzer, attacker-controlled ICC bytes are opened, then cmsReadTag(hProfile, cmsSigGamutTag) stores malformed/incompatible tag data. On cmsSaveProfileToFile, SaveTags dispatches to Type_ViewingConditions_Write for a tag whose Ptr is not actually a cmsICCViewingConditions object (here a smaller LUT/pipeline allocation). Because Type_ViewingConditions_Write does no runtime type/size checks, it performs out-of-bounds reads when serializing IlluminantXYZ/SurroundXYZ/IlluminantType, crashing in _cmsWriteXYZNumber.
